patch_description: The current program uses PACKETS_OUT EWMA (alpha=200) but doesn't actively utilize it in scoring decisions. This edit adds window saturation detection by comparing the smoothed packets_out value against snd_cwnd. When the congestion window is highly utilized (>80% or >95% saturation), we apply a secondary protection boost (+15 or +25 points) independent of the existing RTT-based network_factor. This addresses the recommendation to leverage the enabled PACKETS_OUT listener with conservative fixed-point arithmetic, helping protect the working set during periods of high network utilization without the complexity that caused Generation 42's underperformance (-101.28 points). The boost is small and only applied when window saturation is detected, avoiding sustained over-protection while improving dual_congested performance.
